lines.text: Many learners say: I did a stage at a bank last summer.
Better: I did an internship at a bank last summer.
A stage is for a show. Work for students is an internship.

data.wrong: I did a stage at a bank last summer.
data.right: I did an internship at a bank last summer.
data.why: A stage is for a show. Work for students is an internship.

quiz.stem: It was my first ___ at a big company.

en.tip: In English, “stage” means the place for a show. For a work placement, say “internship”.
